features.title: What she does, exactly
features.subtitle: Nothing complicated. Just what you need when the phone rings all day.

items.d: When you're busy, on a job, or at dinner. Aria picks up and gets what they need.
She checks your calendar, finds the open slot, and books it. On her own.
The customer gets a message with date and time. No more forgotten appointments.
Who wants to buy, who's just asking, who's in a hurry. And she flags it for you.

items.t: Calls back the ones you missed
items.d: The customers you never called back? Aria calls them and picks up where you left off.
Every call, every appointment, all of it written down somewhere.
Receives, forwards, and replies. The important ones reach you already sorted.
Customers get a reminder before their appointment. Fewer no-shows, fewer gaps.
Urgent case or key customer? You get a notification right away.
Forms, information, and requests gathered during the call, ready for you.
FAQs, opening hours, directions: answered instantly without bothering you.
Understands the request and drafts the quote you can send in one click.
If it can be done over the phone, Aria can do it. Write to us and we'll tell you how.

intro.title: Every routine, on autopilot
intro.subtitle: Anything you repeat every day can run on its own. Here's what we build.

items.d: Answers, understands, books. Every call becomes an appointment, even at 3 a.m.
The important ones arrive already picked out, with a draft reply ready to go. The rest file themselves away.
Quotes, invoices, contracts: every file lands in the right place, and you find it right away when you need it.
No customer left behind: Aria reminds you and them, at the right time, on the right channel.
Every week, a summary of your business lands in your inbox: calls, appointments, jobs closed.
Calendars, spreadsheets, CRM, WhatsApp: information travels between your tools on its own, always up to date.

how.title: How it works
how.s1t: You tell us how you work
how.s1d: A twenty-minute call to understand your routine: what you repeat every day, what eats up your time.
how.s2d: In days, not months. Each one is tested on your real business before it goes live.
how.s3d: Every automation tells you what it's doing, and you can stop it whenever you want. No surprises.

cta.title: Tell us about your routine
cta.text: That thing you do every day that eats your time? We can probably take it off your plate. Email us and we'll tell you how.
